title: 2024 Topps Series 2 Stars of the MLB SMLB-32 Spencer Strider - Atlanta Braves
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2024 Topps Series 2 Stars of the MLB SMLB-32 Spencer Strider trading card features the up-and-coming pitcher from the Atlanta Braves. This standard-sized sports trading card is part of the base set released by Topps in 2024, showcasing the up-and-coming star in Major League Baseball. Manufactured with paper materials, this card is a must-have for any baseball card collector looking to add a piece of the Atlanta Braves' talent to their collection. The card does not come autographed, making it a versatile and collectible item for fans of the sport.
